prompt: All four of our report formatters (CsvFormatter, XmlFormatter, JsonFormatter, HtmlFormatter) output dates in MM/DD/YYYY format instead of ISO 8601 (YYYY-MM-DD). Steps to reproduce: generate any report — the date columns are always in US format regardless of locale settings. Each formatter has its own `_format_date` method that calls `date.strftime('%m/%d/%Y')` — it just needs to be changed to `date.isoformat()` in each one.
